A balanced diet is key! Dogs need protein, healthy fats, and fiber. Avoid chocolate, onions, and grapes. For cats, ensure high protein and taurine. Always provide fresh water! 🍖
Core vaccines for dogs include Rabies, DHPP (Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus, Parainfluenza). For cats: Rabies, FVRCP. Consult your vet for a schedule! 💉
Regular grooming keeps your pet healthy! Brush dogs weekly, bathe monthly or as needed. Cats self-clean but need brushing to prevent hairballs. Trim nails regularly! 🛁
Exercise depends on breed and age. Dogs generally need 30-60 mins daily walks. Cats enjoy interactive play with toys. It keeps them fit and happy! 🎾
Fleas and ticks can cause disease. Use vet-approved prevention (collars, drops, pills). Check your pet's fur regularly, especially after outdoor walks. 🐜
If your pet is lethargic, vomiting, bleeding, or ate something toxic, visit a vet IMMEDIATELY. Better safe than sorry! 🚑
Positive reinforcement works best! Use treats and praise. Be consistent and patient. For behavioral issues, consult a professional trainer. 🎓
Early socialization helps pets be confident. Expose them to different people, pets, and sounds gradually in a positive way. 🐕‍🦺
Spaying/neutering prevents unwanted litters and health issues like certain cancers. Consult your vet for the best age to do this. 🏥
Dental health is vital! Brush teeth regularly with pet-safe paste. Dental chews and professional cleanings help prevent gum disease. 🦷
Pets sleep a lot! Dogs: 12-14 hours, Cats: 12-16 hours. Provide a comfortable, quiet bed for quality rest. 💤
